prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original editorial artwork for a Query.Farm engineering blog post and Open Graph card.
Primary request: depict structured database rows being turned into repeatable fingerprints and sorted into buckets, a tactile visual metaphor for hash functions and data interoperability.
Style: sophisticated cut-paper editorial collage and screenprint, warm natural paper grain, restrained hand-made texture, clean silhouettes, gallery quality, no glossy 3D.
Composition: very wide 3:1 panoramic illustration, 1536 by 512 or similar. Spacious cream background (#f7f3ea). On the left, a small stack of three rectangular data records, each subdivided into three colored fields. Across the center, fine curved dark threads lead to bold thumbprint-like concentric ridged oval emblems in ochre and moss green. To the right, the threads continue into three simple open compartment shapes holding matching colored tokens. Clear visual hierarchy, generous negative space, no excessive small detail. Everything fits comfortably within the frame.
Palette: ochre gold (#d5a64b), moss green (#526843), dark umber (#5d4632), cream (#f7f3ea), small terracotta accents.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logos, arrows, padlocks, shields, people or watermark. This illustrates database hashing, not cybersecurity. The graphic will be placed below a separately typeset headline; it must be a finished illustration without any headline.
